nodes.label: Universal Booking Flow
nodes.rationale: Instead of creating separate booking flows for each service, the application uses one reusable booking process whose fields and options adapt to the selected service, ensuring a consistent user experience while reducing duplicate screens and simplifying future maintenance.

nodes.label: Universal Search
nodes.rationale: Instead of providing separate search screens for each service, the application uses one reusable search experience that dynamically adapts based on the selected healthcare service, keeping the experience consistent across services.

nodes.label: Universal Provider Details
nodes.rationale: Rather than creating separate detail screens for Doctors, Hospitals, Home Care, Ambulance, Pharmacy, Diagnostic Labs, and Equipment Rental, one common layout dynamically displays only information relevant to the selected service, reducing duplicate screens.

nodes.label: Universal Booking Details
nodes.rationale: Instead of separate booking-detail screens per healthcare service, one common layout dynamically displays information and available actions based on the selected booking type and its current status.

nodes.label: Universal Booking Timeline
nodes.rationale: A single timeline component is reused across all supported services so the booking-progress experience stays consistent, with only the displayed stages changing per service.

nodes.label: Universal Queue Management
nodes.rationale: A single queue screen is reused only for services where queue-based appointments apply (Doctor Consultation, Hospital & Clinic, Diagnostic Lab), improving patient visibility into waiting times without a bespoke screen per service.

nodes.label: Universal Tracking
nodes.rationale: A single tracking screen is reused for dispatch/delivery-style services (Home Care, Ambulance, Pharmacy, Equipment Rental); queue-based services instead rely on the Booking Timeline and Queue Management, since live tracking does not fit their appointment model.

nodes.label: Universal Cancellation
nodes.rationale: A single cancellation flow is reused across all services, with available options and outcome adapting to service, booking status, and the provider's cancellation policy, avoiding a bespoke cancellation UI per service.

nodes.label: Universal Rebooking
nodes.rationale: A single rebooking flow reuses information from a prior booking to pre-populate a new one, minimizing patient re-entry effort while keeping the new booking fully independent (own reference and status) from the original.

nodes.label: Universal Document Upload
nodes.rationale: Referenced by the Pharmacy module's prescription upload step so that document-format validation and upload behavior are reused from one common mechanism instead of a service-specific implementation.
